clause_name: RLA-260 — Residential Lease — Environmental Materials and Lead Renovation
library_question: Do the property-specific asbestos and lead-renovation cautions apply pending verified construction-year and lead-workflow facts?

blocks.text: Because the property may have been built before 1981, some building materials may contain asbestos or other regulated materials. Tenant may not scrape, sand, drill, cut, disturb, remove, or attach anything to walls, ceilings, flooring, insulation, pipe wrap, texture, tile, or other suspect materials in a manner that may release dust or fibers without Landlord's prior written consent. Tenant must promptly report damaged or deteriorated building materials, ceiling leaks, loose tiles, or similar conditions.

Because the property was built before 1978 or is being treated as pre-1978 housing for disclosure purposes, Tenant may not scrape, sand, remove, drill, cut, disturb, renovate, repair, or paint surfaces in a manner that may disturb lead-based paint without Landlord's prior written consent. Tenant must report deteriorated paint promptly. Any lead-related work must be handled by Landlord or properly certified professionals as required by law.
